title: Other New Orleans bass players he admired
summary: He recalls a small bassist with a big bass in Sam's band, and old man Kimball, and trades names such as Jimmy Brown and Manuel Perez.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I'm trying to think of the bass player Sam had. He was a little guy and he had a great big bass. The first time I ever saw a console bass. It's a great big thing.

No, let me see. I know his name if I heard him. He was a very fine bass player. He was the first guy outside of Simon Maria that... And old man Kimball that I've ever saw finger bass correctly. You see?
Jimmy Brown. Do you remember him?
Let me see. Jimmy Brown. Jimmy Brown.
Manuel Perez. Jimmy Brown. I don't know. There's names now. It's really gone from me. I used to know that name.
Are there any other bass players you remember? Do you remember Jimmy Johnson when you were here?
